**ACCEPT** — `domain:devx @ objectui` execution seat, PM session `session_01FhBNJcLRZLe8M87VcUgpKr`, R46, reviewed 2026-09-07T19:40Z against GitHub and the tree, ⛔ never against the report's narrative.

## The diff is exactly two lines of substance, and the exclusion was refused

One file, `+85/-14`, draft, head `001bb74a1`. Scanning the patch for member additions returns exactly **two**: `'@object-ui/plugin-view'` and `'@object-ui/core'`. ⛔ **`@object-ui/components/ui/sonner` was not added**, as the brief required — the trap with the mechanical tripwire was refused on purpose.

⚠️ And the dev sharpened the dispatch's framing of it, correctly: this seat wrote that three specifiers "are not members", which is true, but the dev measured that `@object-ui/components/ui/sonner` already classifies as scope **`covered`** by prefix reach, so **it was never part of the 12 other-workspace sites** in the first place. The brief's conclusion was right; its arithmetic framing invited the reading that there were three uncovered specifiers when there were two.

## The re-derivation was retaken, not inherited — including from a paragraph that argued the opposite

Both figures re-derived on `d9788c141` through the gate's own `scan()` under a local `covered` override: `@object-ui/plugin-view` **10 / 10 / 0**, `@object-ui/core` **2 / 2 / 0**. No frozen factory turned up, so no sweep was folded in and no test file is touched.

⭐ **Worth recording because it is where this fold could have gone wrong:** slice 14's own header paragraph — written yesterday, by another dev, and *still on main until this PR* — said of these two specifiers "which is why they are still owed a slice each: the precondition below is a MEASUREMENT, and a specifier that reads zero frozen today can carry a frozen factory tomorrow." That prose argued **against** folding. It is not a maintainer ruling and not a triage decision, so this seat's gate-by-gate fold decision overrides it — but only because the brief demanded the measurement be **retaken on today's tree rather than inherited from that very paragraph**, and it was. Had either specifier moved overnight, the fold would have been wrong and the dev was instructed to sweep and say so. ⭐ The PR replaces that paragraph in the same diff, so code and prose do not disagree on main.

## The arithmetic that licenses `Fixes`, confirmed before it was written

Census `648 judged / 648 inherit / 0 frozen / 12 other workspace` → **`660 / 660 / 0 / 0`**. Judged rose by exactly **12 = 10 + 2**, and **`other workspace` reached 0**. Diffed **per site across all 1,785 call sites on verdict AND reason string**: exactly 12 rows changed, every one `workspace/unjudged → covered/inherits`, the other 1,773 byte-identical — a ratchet, nothing moved the other way.

22 named specifiers = 21 package roots (now all members) + the one subpath covered by reach. ⇒ No slice remains, `Fixes #6892` is correct, and GitHub registered it: the card's `closed_by_pull_requests` names this PR. The dev states plainly that had `other workspace` not reached 0, the body would have said `Refs`.

## ⭐ The header's closing statement is the part worth reading twice

Two things the dev wrote that this seat did not ask for and would have wanted:

1. **The membership rule is protected against the precedent this slice sets.** The header now reads that the list holds twenty-one, "nineteen joined by sweep, and the last two … by a MEASUREMENT that found nothing to sweep, **which is the degenerate case of the same precondition and not a second door**". Without that sentence the next reader could conclude a member may join by judgement — which is exactly what the grow-only rule forbids and what fourteen slices of sweeping paid for.
2. **Three explicit non-guarantees** are recorded against the green: `other workspace` will not stay 0 by itself; a member reading zero frozen today can carry a frozen factory tomorrow; and a **third-party** frozen neighbour can still kill a file during collection, which this gate by construction does not judge. ⇒ A worklist closing at zero is the moment a reader is most likely to mistake a measurement for a permanent guarantee, and the file now refuses that reading in its own words.

## Verification

`node scripts/check-vi-mock-inherit.mjs` exits 0 with both new members named and `0 other workspace`. The gate's own pin suite is green at **84/84** through the shared lock — and the two load-bearing pins here are the ones the brief flagged: every member must name a real `packages/DIR/package.json` whose `name` matches (`packages/plugin-view` and `packages/core` both do), and every member must be a package **root**. That second pin is precisely what adding the sonner subpath would have reddened.

Changeset **measured, not guessed**: `check-changeset-presence` exits 0 with "0 of them published source" — the fourteen earlier slices each owed one because they edited test files under a published package's `src/`; this one touches only `scripts/`. One NOT-MEASURED datum is recorded rather than reported as a pass: `check:readme-exports` exits 1 in an unbuilt worktree for all 532 lines ("run pnpm build first"), a prerequisite failure structurally independent of a diff touching no README and no package.

Not governed surface. PR stays draft; the flip is this seat's read.

Next: CI convergence → flip ready → post-flip guard → auto-merge SQUASH → queue confirmation → landing probe (both members present in `COVERED_SPECIFIERS` on re-fetched `origin/main`, and **⛔ `@object-ui/components/ui/sonner` still absent from it**; control: the gate's own post-merge push run must print **`660 … judged (660 inherit, 0 auto-mocked); 0 other workspace`**) → LANDED here and on #6892, which **closes** via `Fixes` — the first and only slice for which that verb is right.

**Content probe on re-fetched `origin/main` (tip `4b5e07a53`, read 20:07Z)** — both claims from the Armed note, and the exclusion:

1. **21 members**, with `'@object-ui/plugin-view'` and `'@object-ui/core'` both present.
2. ⛔ **`@object-ui/components/ui/sonner` is ABSENT** from the constant, as required. Checked structurally as well as by name: every one of the 21 members splits into exactly two path segments, so **no member is a subpath** — the invariant PR #8391 pinned mechanically still holds on main.

**Control, read from the gate RUNNING on merged main** ([34158071665](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectui/actions/runs/34158071665), head `4b5e07a53`, step completed 20:05:52Z):

```
✅  check-vi-mock-inherit: OK (4458 tracked source file(s), 2724 test-named; 616 carry a mock;
    660 call site(s) on …, @object-ui/app-shell, @object-ui/plugin-view, @object-ui/core
    and their subpaths judged (660 inherit, 0 auto-mocked);
    0 other workspace, 243 external, 879 local, …)
```

⇒ **660 judged / 660 inherit / 0 frozen / 0 other workspace.** `660 + 0 = 660`, the same total as the pre-change `648 + 12`, so the twelve moved from unjudged into judged and nothing moved the other way.

⭐ Why the census reading was the load-bearing half of this control rather than a formality: adding two names to the list is trivially green on its own — the gate would print the longer list and the same 648 either way. **A member added without its measurement is indistinguishable from one added with it, except by the count.** The count moved by exactly 12, which is what makes "joined by measurement" a fact rather than a claim.

## The end state, and what it is not

Every `@object-ui/*` specifier any `vi.mock` or `vi.doMock` call site in this tree names is now judged, and `other workspace` reads **0** for the first time since the gate was built. ⛔ That is not a permanent guarantee, and the PR says so in the file rather than leaving the green to be misread: `other workspace` will not stay 0 by itself; a member reading zero frozen today can carry a frozen factory tomorrow; and a **third-party** frozen neighbour can still kill a file during collection, which this gate by construction does not judge.
